about: Diagrams in generalized parity form on which the row-reduction alternation of reduce_gpf (gadget passes off) needs three or four rounds, some with a later round that changes the diagram without deleting a spider. Each has an edge between a Z-spider not on an input and an X-spider not on an output, which the output of to_gpf never has (appendix A of the paper). Random bipartite diagrams, seed 2026, built directly rather than through to_gpf; vertices are listed in order, which fixes the pivot choices.
